skill.name: minimax-music-gen
skill.description: Generate vocal, instrumental, and cover tracks with MiniMax Music through the mmx CLI. The skill helps plan prompts, handle lyrics, save audio files, play results, and iterate on feedback.
skill.summary: Generate MiniMax vocal, instrumental, and cover tracks from prompts, lyrics, references, and style controls.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: The reviewed files describe a MiniMax music generation workflow that relies on the mmx CLI and the MiniMax API. Most scanner hits are Markdown backticks or benign prompt-writing prose, but the workflow includes external CLI execution, global package installation, persistent API credential storage, and user-controlled command arguments. No evidence found of prompt injection instructions or malicious data exfiltration intent.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before authentication and document that mmx stores credentials under the user home directory.
Build commands with argument arrays or safely escaped temporary files, never raw shell interpolation.
Ask for user approval before npm install -g and recommend verifying the package source and version.
Ask before launching local players and validate that playback targets remain inside the generated output directory.

semantic_findings.description: The skill templates pass prompts, lyrics, audio file paths, and URLs from the user into mmx command arguments. If an agent builds these commands through a shell, unsafe quoting could cause command injection or unintended file and URL access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command templates show user-controlled placeholders for prompt, lyrics, source files, and source URLs in mmx invocations. The skill is documentation rather than executable code, so the risk depends on agent implementation.

content.value_statement: Creating complete songs from short ideas usually needs lyrics, arrangement, and production choices. This skill turns a music brief into MiniMax CLI steps for vocal, instrumental, and cover tracks.
actual_capabilities: Expands short music ideas into detailed English prompts for MiniMax Music.
Supports basic generation and advanced planning for lyrics, genre, mood, vocals, and structure.
Generates vocal tracks with automatic lyrics or user-provided lyrics.
Generates instrumental tracks with genre, mood, instrument, BPM, and structure controls.
Creates cover-style tracks from a local audio file or audio URL.
Saves generated files, attempts local playback, and supports feedback-based regeneration.
limitations: Requires the mmx CLI, a MiniMax API key, network access, and available account quota.
Authentication stores credentials in the local mmx configuration directory.
Playback needs mpv, ffplay, or afplay on the local machine.
Copyrighted lyrics and filtered content must be rewritten or avoided.

use_cases.title: Draft a Song Demo
use_cases.description: Turn a rough theme into a vocal track with lyrics, genre, mood, and production direction.

use_cases.title: Create Background Music
use_cases.description: Generate instrumental music for videos, presentations, prototypes, or ambient scenes.

use_cases.title: Explore Cover Styles
use_cases.description: Use a reference audio file or URL to create a new cover-style version with original lyrics.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Simple Track
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one clear mood or scene.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an instrumental track for a calm evening study session with warm piano, soft pads, and gentle percussion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Vocal Song
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants lyrics and vocals from a theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a hopeful indie pop song about starting over after a difficult year. Use clear English lyrics and a warm female vocal.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Lyrics and Style
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with editable lyrics and production choices.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my lyrics and help refine the chorus. Then suggest genre, mood, vocal tone, instruments, and structure before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cover Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using reference audio and strict style direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cover-style version from my audio file with original lyrics, acoustic guitar, intimate vocals, and a slower tempo.

output_examples.input: Generate a sad piano piece for a rainy city scene.
output_examples.output: A preview lists an instrumental track with melancholic piano, light strings, slow tempo, and a saved MP3 path after generation.

output_examples.input: Turn these lyrics into an upbeat pop song.
output_examples.output: The skill formats the lyrics, proposes a pop prompt with vocal and production details, asks for confirmation, then generates the track.

output_examples.input: Make an acoustic cover from this local audio file.
output_examples.output: The skill asks for the source file and cover style, then creates a new version and offers playback or regeneration.

best_practices: Give a clear mood, genre, tempo range, and two or three important instruments.
Confirm lyrics, style, and output path before running generation.
Use original lyrics for covers and avoid copyrighted text.
anti_patterns: Do not paste copyrighted lyrics and ask for direct reproduction.
Do not pass untrusted file paths or URLs without checking them first.
Do not run authentication or package installation without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill generate audio directly?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses the mmx CLI to call MiniMax Music and save generated audio files locally.

faq.question: Do I need a MiniMax API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The mmx CLI must be authenticated with a MiniMax API key before generation works.

faq.question: Can it create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports instrumental generation with genre, mood, instruments, tempo, and structure controls.

faq.question: Can I provide my own lyrics?
faq.answer: Yes. You can provide lyrics, edit sections, or let the lyrics optimizer generate lyrics from a theme.

faq.question: Can it make cover versions?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports cover-style generation from a local audio file or an audio URL.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The skill saves generated tracks under the MiniMax music output directory in the user home folder.
